project_name: SIH 26008 — MineGuard AI: AI-Based Industrial Conveyor Belt Defect Detection and Monitoring System
problem_statement: Autonomous real-time detection, orientation-invariant localization, severity classification, and failsafe motor interlock control for conveyor belts in heavy mining environments.
inference_pipeline: Unified Preprocessing (EXIF normalization, BGR conversion, RGB PIL rendering) -> SmartOrientationRouter -> Ultralytics YOLO11s (800x800) -> Inverse Bounding-Box Coordinate Transformation & IoU Fusion -> Hardware Safety Controller FSM
orientation_router: SmartOrientationRouter: Evaluates aspect ratio (W/H). Standard landscape (W/H >= 0.8) executes Fast Path (angle 0 deg). Portrait / anomalous ratio (W/H < 0.75 or 0 detections on portrait) activates Fallback Multi-View Path (angles 0, 90, 270 deg) with geometric inverse transformation and duplicate suppression.
fast_path: Single-pass forward inference at 0 deg orientation for landscape frames. Verified latency: P50 = 163.85ms, P95 = 221.82ms.
fallback_path: Multi-angle evaluation ([0, 90, 270] degrees) with coordinate inverse affine mapping and IoU fusion (threshold 0.45). Verified latency: P50 = 156.44ms, P95 = 162.80ms.
safety_state_machine: 9-State Deterministic FSM: SYSTEM_INIT, SYSTEM_READY, BELT_RUNNING, DEFECT_DETECTED, BELT_STOPPED, NO_DETECTIONS, ANALYSIS_ERROR, EMERGENCY_STOP, HARDWARE_FAULT. Critical defects (Longitudinal Tear, Belt Splice) trip STOP_CONVEYOR and engage a latch. Latch is persistent across clean frames until authorized operator reset.
camera_configuration: Index 0, DirectShow API (Windows backend), CV_CAP_PROP_BUFFERSIZE=1, Asynchronous Threaded LatestFrameCapture (Latest-Frame-Wins ring buffer, zero queue lag), raw capture ~40 FPS, decoupled inference ~7.56 FPS (112ms per frame).
hardware_mode: SIMULATION (Safe demonstration profile: PHYSICAL_HARDWARE_VERIFIED=False, relay output simulated, 24V contactors de-energized for lab safety).
reset_procedure: 1. Physically inspect conveyor belt. 2. Verify all maintenance clearances. 3. Dispatch authorized operator reset token via POST /api/operator_reset or web dashboard 'Reset Safety Latch' button. 4. Verify latch is cleared in /api/hardware_status. 5. State transitions from BELT_STOPPED to SYSTEM_READY. 6. Actuator command transitions from STOP_CONVEYOR to CONTINUE.
known_limitations: Hardware control operates in SIMULATION mode; physical 24V contactor and STM32 UART relay boards require optoisolated field wiring before industrial live energization.

Webcam DirectShow frame rate on CPU laptop is ~7.56 FPS decoupled inference (112-163ms latency); target edge deployment on NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano with TensorRT INT8/FP16 yields >30 FPS industrial line-rate.
Dataset class imbalance: slight scratch and belt splice have fewer real mining site samples than longitudinal tear and normal belt.
